registry_disposition.reason: This change hardens the source security gate's baseline matching after its first real collision with a co-lane's legitimate edit: the s5-frontdoor-evidence lane's pull request 68 moved the baselined non-literal import in scripts/tools/run-skill-effectiveness-evals.mjs from line 723 to line 788, which made the line-keyed baseline stale and the gate red on the merged main. The match key is now file plus rule plus the reported code line's excerpt, so a disclosure survives a line move, a changed line is still stale, a second identical occurrence is still unbaselined (matching consumes the entry), and legacy entries without an excerpt keep the line-based match. All existing baseline entries were rebound to their excerpts from a live scan and the drift test's own fixture content is disclosed. The change touches the gate's matching rule and its baseline and test file only: no contract, corpus, record format, digest, ownership, lifecycle state, authority or dependency class changes, no npm dependency is added, and the registration of this adjustment is the new run change registration in the Registry; the Atlas representation trails it.
